ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly high-intensity (white) pixels covering approximately 95% of the visible surface, contrasted by a thin margin of low-intensity (black) pixels along the trailing edge.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity white field across the central and medial regions; discrete, irregular low-intensity black pixel clusters are localized exclusively along the trailing edge boundary and median notch.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with an approximate 40-degree internal angle and a sharp, well-defined apex.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern with pixel-amplitude variations across the entire trailing edge; notably jagged peaks are concentrated on the lateral thirds of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex sweep trajectory originating from the median notch and extending symmetrically towards the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct clusters of high-contrast, multi-tonal circular blobs (barnacles) are localized on the far lateral edge of the left lobe and the distal tip of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive biological colonization (barnacles) present on the outer lateral margins of both the left and right lobes.
